name: Thabo Cele
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, watching local stock car races in Durban. He was immediately captivated by the engineering and the constant push for innovation. After completing his technical training, he landed an apprenticeship with a touring car team, quickly proving his aptitude for composite materials. His meticulous approach and dedication to quality earned him a reputation for reliability.

At Ipiranga Racing, Thabo focuses on optimizing the aerodynamic performance of the cars through advanced composite design and repair. He believes in a hands-on approach, preferring to be on the shop floor directly involved in the fabrication process. He's known for his ability to troubleshoot complex issues with composite structures and his relentless pursuit of perfection.

physical.description: A powerfully built man with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and notes.
Has an uncanny ability to detect even the slightest imperfections in composite layups.
Refuses to start work until he's had a cup of strong rooibos tea.
